title: Pay today, save 35%
scenario: A caller says an old medical balance was sent to collections but can be closed today for 35% less. They know the provider name and date of service and offer a payment link by text.

answers.A: Contact the provider or collector through independently verified contact details and request written validation before paying.
answers.B: Check your insurance explanation of benefits and provider portal to see whether the balance exists.
answers.C: Pay the discounted amount now because the details match a real visit and the deal may disappear.

explanation: Real medical details can be combined with fake collection pressure. Verify who owns the debt before settling it.
proTip: A discount is not a substitute for debt validation.
